patthana24.5:1.1: na hetuṃ no saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu saññojano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.5:2.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka noganthagocchakaduke hetuduka ganthagocchakadukaṃ
patthana24.5:3.1: na hetuṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu gantho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.5:4.1: hetuyā nava. nahetuduka nooghagocchakaduke hetuduka oghagocchakadukaṃ
patthana24.5:5.1: na hetuṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ogho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.5:6.1: hetuyā pañca. nahetuduka noyogagocchakaduke hetuduka yogagocchakadukaṃ
patthana24.5:7.1: na hetuṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu yogo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.5:8.1: hetuyā pañca. hetuduka nonīvaraṇagocchakaduke hetuduka nīvaraṇagocchakadukaṃ
patthana24.5:9.1: na hetuṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu nīvaraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana24.5:10.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nahetuduka noparāmāsagocchakaduke hetuduka parāmāsagocchakadukaṃ
patthana24.5:11.1: na hetuṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu parāmāso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
